opening.argument: The video presents a first-person operational demonstration of creating a StrongBlock node, not a guaranteed-income solicitation. The presenter explains that 10 STRONG tokens are used to create one node and walks through exchanging Ethereum, approving STRONG, and selecting the node-creation function. The approximately $8,000 cost and continuing fee are disclosed, along with the possibility that the node may be removed if the monthly fee is not paid. Although the title references “CRAZY Passive Income” and the dashboard displays rewards, the presenter also characterizes the activity as risky and says it is not financial advice. Those disclosures, together with the visible setup and fee mechanics, do not establish fraudulent mining-share sales or promise viewers a guaranteed payout.
